hierarchy.policy: only observed pre-inner-cut subzones; retain at least one observed subzone per parent planning area
hierarchy.parent_coverage: every held child has a retained training parent

mrt.assignment: nearest January-2021 station, no radius cutoff; distance supplied to all arms
mrt.inputs: static building/amenity summaries and station descriptors; no rent aggregates or station IDs
mrt.architecture: one bottom-up pooling, three station updates, one top-down readout; local residual retained
mrt.limitations: exploratory inspected windows; fixed 2021 MRT graph; straight-line access, not travel time

interpretation: exploratory inspected windows; two-seed prediction ensembles; one geographic assignment per experiment; intervals condition on fixed predictions
